mistake_reason: The orchestrator insisted on repeatedly reloading and re-checking the same X profile with identical parameters despite already having a valid, consistent follower count. This step repetition (FM-1.3) caused unnecessary reiteration of a completed verification, diverted effort away from resolving the gated LinkedIn count, and biased the team toward the repeatedly confirmed X value. As a result, the team prematurely concluded X had the most followers, ignoring that LinkedIn’s actual count (gated but higher) contradicts the final answer.
